Native1 is soft and the shaft has subtle wear/edge light at larger scales, a qualification rather than a missing-footprint blocker.

The full trailing cyan arcs/streaks return in Source-like placement, while hull/pointed bow retain the phase shape. Bright silver edges/regular plating are an interpretation and the trails intentionally retain coarse Source steps.

Second pose retains its distinct trailing streak pattern and Source phase boundary while preserving the same hull construction. Higher-scale bevels and vent/grille detail remain continuous; no gross body jump or new silhouette collapse is seen against the other pose. Native1 is softer/brighter than Original.

Rounded red lens, recessed dark vent, small screws and copper/steel bevels provide meaningful generated form at3/4. Source-like outer-ring placement is preserved and the Source-empty leftmost column stays clear. More regular circular cavities and brighter copper/metal are a sculpted material interpretation.

The complete2 phase changes at the outer ring remain visible without a moving stripe entering the empty left column. Continuous lens/housing finish remains consistent with1033e; the stepped perimeter and native1 soft highlight are visible limits. The dark lower vent is more regular/round than the low-resolution Original shading.
